newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho expects hotels decision by end-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho expects hotels decision by end-Sept.

text.p: British conglomerate Lonrho Plc has received a "variety of bids" from an unspecified number of parties from Britain and overseas for its Princess and Metropole hotels group and expects to make a decision on their future by the end of September, a spokesman told Reuters.

Earlier Lonrho said it had decided to defer publication of its prospectus for the flotation of its Princess and Metropole hotel groups in response to approaches by a number of parties for all or part of the group.

He said Lonrho expected to issue a clear statement of what would happen next by the end of this month, adding the options for the hotels group were to continue with flotation as planned or a partial or total "trade sale" (to another hotel group).
